object_description: tower-like addition interlocked with existing building volumes
design_condition: The new volume occupies the plot edge and continues the adjacent street line, but rises prominently above the surrounding buildings and leaves a narrow, heavily shaded gap beside the existing structures.

positive.statement: The existing buildings are handled correctly and retained without unnecessary expansion or additional basement floors.

position.rationale: Existing retained volumes appear as the lower, irregular mass around the compact vertical addition.

positive.statement: The foyer and two-storey reading room are cleverly arranged and attractively designed.

position.rationale: Interior rooms are not distinguishable; anchored near the lower southern portion of the sampled building.

positive.statement: The sustainability focus and building-technology and fire-protection concepts are essentially viable.

position.target: sustainability and building-technology and fire-protection concepts
position.rationale: This evaluates building systems without a specific geometric location.

negative.statement: The tall new building appears too dominant in relation to the existing protected building and the urban context.

position.rationale: The prominent vertical volume rises above the lower surrounding mass and dominates the sampled elevations.

negative.statement: The interlocking connection is disproportionate and unresolved in construction and design terms.

position.rationale: The connection is located where the diagonal lower volume meets the upright mass.

negative.statement: The functional links between the different areas, especially administration and the adult library, are not satisfactorily resolved.

position.target: functional links between administration and adult library
position.rationale: Internal links are not visible; the anchor uses the central interface between the sampled volumes.

negative.statement: The material expression of the façade seems strange in the urban-development context.

position.rationale: The exterior expression is assigned to the dominant exposed side of the new volume.

negative.statement: Barrier-free construction is achieved only with restrictions.

position.rationale: Accessibility performance has no identifiable spatial marker in the exterior point cloud.
